findings.quoted_finding: Several source_record_ids in the governed AC ledger are semantically misaligned or incomplete even though the source hashes and mathematical proof paths are correct.
defect_evidence: AMX-012 is a pure-pattern impossibility claim, not a general type-first or payoff-date claim.
AUX-MSB-021 is the nu=0 endpoint, while AUX-MSB-020 is the general type-before-prior record.
AUX-MSB-025 is atomic-binder preservation, while AUX-MSB-031 is the same-prior and same-(rho,nu_off)-fiber downstream rule.
The complete A_U partition requires cells AUX-MSB-010 through AUX-MSB-014, interior exhaustion AUX-MSB-015 and endpoints AUX-MSB-021 and AUX-MSB-022.

findings.reasoning: The mathematical proofs and source hashes are correct, but the literal record IDs route an auditor to unrelated or incomplete source claims. This is a bounded traceability defect rather than a theorem defect.
findings.disposition: Change only the eight affected source_record_ids fields to the exact source claims listed in the Markdown adjudication; repin the ledger, rerun the verifier, issue a new manifest and obtain fresh independent review.
